ambiguities.text: Blocks previously validated as satisfying the inclusion list constraints SHOULD NOT be invalidated even if their associated InclusionLists have subsequently been pruned.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume once a block passes IL satisfaction check, the result is cached permanently in the store and never re-evaluated, even if the inclusion lists used for validation are later garbage collected.

ambiguities.text: The conditions for proposer reorg ('shuffling stability, FFG competitiveness, finalization health') are referenced but not precisely quantified in this spec section.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these conditions follow the existing proposer boost reorg logic from the base fork choice specification, extended to also require IL satisfaction failure.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine's is_inclusion_list_satisfied() function correctly determines whether a payload includes the required transactions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A faulty or compromised execution engine could falsely report satisfaction, allowing censoring proposers to bypass inclusion list enforcement.

implicit_assumptions.description: Inclusion lists can propagate through the P2P network to all honest validators before the VIEW_FREEZE_CUTOFF (75% of slot).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Late-arriving inclusion lists could cause honest validators to have inconsistent views, leading to disagreements on block validity and potential short-lived forks.

implicit_assumptions.description: A proposer cannot selectively withhold their block to avoid inclusion list enforcement while still receiving attestations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Strategic block withholding could allow proposers to censor transactions while maintaining chain weight through carefully timed late releases.
